strings.en: Are you feeling all right, Excellen?
...Yes. Sorry to have worried you...
He didn't show it, but... Kyosuke was really worried about you.
Heh, what're you talking about? It was written all over his face.
Wow! Tell me more stuff like that, lots and lots more!
...More importantly, we need to discuss the Einst.
Hey, come on, why do you always do that...
That's right. Sorting things out once would help us going forward.
Ah, you too, Cecily!
...Man, what a lively person.
But it's great she hasn't changed one bit!
We need somebody this cheerful around.
Hey, hey? That makes it sound like I'm an airhead.
Seems she's aware of it.
Now, now, calm down...
Could you tell us about the Einst?
...Thing is... I don't really remember much... honestly.
You did seem kind of sleepy.
If I recall, Excellen and Kyosuke... you two were both
in a shuttle accident, weren't you?
...You told them about that, Kyosuke?
Yeah.
In that accident, you two survived miraculously... no, inexplicably...
Were the Einst series really behind it back then?
A miraculous survival... It is indeed an inexplicable phenomenon,
but there may be some other reason...
Why would that accident connect to the Einst?
Yeah, good point...
I don't know how that accident ties in with them either, but...
...Why was it you?
Huh? Why was what?
...Why did the Einst control you... and not me?
Hmm, maybe they prefer a young woman over a stone-faced grump...
(...Harsh.)
...Answer seriously.
Hmm, if the accident and the Einst are connected,
then it'd be no surprise if Kyosuke had been the one controlled... right?
That's true. Is there some reason?
A reason, huh...
...Excellen, I heard you flew off into the Dark Zone?
I don't really... remember, but... probably.
Could that ring of rocks have something to do with it?
That place... is probably their point of contact with this world...
An entrance and exit, I think.
The ones around the Saotome Laboratory on Earth were the same.
Stone Circle... Then the Stone Circles scattered all over Earth too!?
Since the Einst series seems to have existed since ancient times...
that may well be the case.
Hmm... Then what is their objective?
...The Einst's ultimate goal... the extinction of humanity...?
You don't really think that, do you, Kyosuke?
No. If that were it, they'd attack in a more straightforward way.
There'd be no need for such baffling behavior.
Then it's simple. They don't mean to kill us, yet they keep meddling with
humans this much... They must be observing us.
I agree. Domon, it seems you've developed an eye for things.
My, Domon, you're sharp today. But that would explain it...
They came to the Saotome Laboratory for the Getter Rays...
They've appeared in Byston Well too.
Show Zama's group being summoned via the Aura Road in the first place...
They've meddled... that far?
I'm not certain... but they're definitely involved with the Aura Road...
In other words... they're looking for a power to wipe out humanity?
Then why only Earth?
None of the other enemies have been attacked by the Einst... Why's that?
If they just wanted to wipe us out, they wouldn't need
to do anything that complicated, would they?
That's right... They could just come at us with their overwhelming forces...
Their fixation on Earth's people... means there's some other reason...?
Ooh, ooh! Aren't we still forgetting something?
What about that girl, Alchemie?
Yeah, what's with that girl? Didn't she seem kinda like Excellen?
Being young sure is enviable, huh.
...Jokes aside, I don't really know much about that girl either.
...But, probably...
What is she?
A person being controlled by the Einst, like you were?
Or else...
That girl is... my...
Everyone, to the bridge. We'll be talking to Commander Hazuki soon.
...The land of beginnings, Earthlings...
...That being the situation, we're going to storm Demon Island.
I see. So it's the final battle with the Demon Empire at last...
Nah, if they go wild like always, even the Demon Empire'll run away!
With those guys rampaging, even allies would hesitate to get close.
They can scare people off just by yelling!
Ahaha, so true, so true.
And if the King of Hearts is in the mix, even I'd run for the hills.
Heh heh...
Hey, what's that supposed to mean!?
Honestly... You're barely back and already getting carried away.
So Excellen has returned as well.
A lot has happened, but all in all, that's a relief, eh, Nanbu?
Commander Hazuki, have you met up with Rom and the others yet?
Yes. It came as a surprise, but... they saved us.
...Captain Bright, is everything all right on your end?
We've checked every suspicious point, and things had calmed down...
Or so I could have said until just a moment ago...
Huh? Captain, is there new information?
Yes. We've finally caught the Vega Star Federation's movements.
The Vega Star Federation!? They've been quiet... Did you find something!?
We just got word from Von Braun...
The Vega Star Federation has been building a forward base
on the far side of the Moon from Earth. In secret, and very carefully.
A secret base!? When did they build that...
Hmph, to build a stronghold unnoticed in the enemy's blind spot...
They are not to be underestimated.
So that's why they were so fixated on the Moon...!
We've been to the Moon so many times, and never noticed...
Whenever Londo Bell goes to the Moon, it's always total chaos, huh.
An unwelcome jinx, but true enough.
...Commander Hazuki, we'll strike the Vega Star Federation base at once.
Good luck to you there. Please give my regards to Queen Sheela as well.
Understood. Good luck to you as well, Captain Bright.
May the Kenrou guide you.
Kenrou...? Could it be...
...Yes, Rom's group chased the Gyandlar off into the sky again...
I expect they'll join up with you...
Huh!? That guy's wandering off again!?
...Sigh, it can't be helped. Commander Hazuki, stay safe.
You've all heard it.
The Ra Cailum will strike the Vega Star Federation's lunar base!
King Vega... At last I've found you... Feel Fleed's fury, and mine!
Brother, I'm coming too!
I've heard the story, but... it's rare to see Daisuke this fired up.
They destroyed his home planet... There's no way he can forgive that!
Princess Lamba... Someday, we too shall take on the Bunker...!
Get too heated and the enemy will trip you up. Stay on your guard.
By the way, how are Captain Quattro and Captain Burning doing...?
We heard they safely joined up with the Nadesico... but it's Mars, after all.
Right now, we still don't have enough detail to stay in touch with Earth...
The Elshank's fine, but can the Nadesico do that Boson Jump thing
again? Sounded like a pretty risky tightrope act...
Even if they manage to join up, they might not be able to come back...
But apart from the Elshank, there's no ship that can teleport...
What're you talking about? There's a handy guy around, ain't there?
Can teleport... and handy...? Oh! That shady doctor!
That's right, if we use the Daldal's warp beam...!
I see... Then, without relying on the unstable Boson Jump,
they could get back from Mars quickly...
But is it all right to just ask him like that?
It's fine, it's fine. The Doc may not look it, but he can't say no.
Yeah, yeah, just use him however's convenient.
I kinda feel a little sorry for Dr. Tarsan...
...Maybe so.
All right... Mia, please get in touch with Dr. Tarsan.
With the doctor in hiding, the only ones who can reach him right away
are probably the Dangaioh team.
Understood. I'll let him know right away.
Captain, we'll get ready for battle too.
Good. Everyone, stay battle-ready.
It's a Vega Star Federation base. This will be a fierce fight...!
